auth.loginLead: Only registered users can open the dashboard.
auth.registerLead: Create a local account. Brain will then read your website.
auth.name: Name

onboarding.title: Learn the brand
onboarding.lead: Paste the website. We read the brand and prepare a growth audit and a foundation. You can adjust each part on its own.
onboarding.extracting: Reading the website and its key inner pages, then writing each section in full. This can take a few minutes.
onboarding.reviewLead: Each part is stored on its own, so you can change it now and again later in Brain.
onboarding.visualsLead: Logo, images, colours and fonts from the site.

groupHints.website: How the site lands, which scores stand out, and what to do first.
groupHints.seo: Crawlability, clarity, quotability and authorship, plus prompts for a code editor.
groupHints.listing: How the product should read in listings and distribution channels.
groupHints.brief: What the product is, who it is for, and how it sounds.
groupHints.audience: Who has the problem, who pays, and which patterns to avoid.
groupHints.competitors: The field, and where this brand can credibly win.

hints.quickWins: Small changes you can make quickly.
hints.thisQuarter: Work that should happen this quarter.
hints.fixes: One recommendation per theme, with a prompt you can paste into an IDE or code editor.
hints.hero: The hero, copied from the site rather than rewritten.
hints.spotlight: Two rivals set next to each other.
hints.whereWeWin: Only positions this brand can credibly claim.

fix.prompt: Prompt for an IDE or code editor

brain.title: Brain
brain.lead: This profile is used in strategy, social, SEO and outreach.
brain.files: The logo and images live in the Brain folder of your files.
brain.dossierLead: Adjust the growth audit and the foundation on their own pages. The profile still travels with strategy, social, SEO and outreach.
brain.rerunLead: The website will be read again. The saved growth audit, foundation, colours, fonts and images will be overwritten, including changes you made afterwards.

audit.title: Audit
audit.lead: View and edit the growth audit: website optimization, SEO and listing optimization.
audit.empty: There is no brand profile yet. Finish onboarding first.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.lead: View and edit the product brief, the audience and the competitors.
foundation.empty: There is no brand profile yet. Finish onboarding first.

files.title: Files
files.lead: Folders for uploads, edits and what Brain collects from your website. Changes arrive live.
files.deleteFolder: Delete this folder and everything inside?

home.lead: Your brand, schedule and open conversations in one place.

strategy.title: Business strategy
strategy.lead: Talk through positioning, offer and priorities with the brand profile as context.

social.title: Social media
social.lead: Connect accounts, draft posts and schedule them on the calendar.
social.appLead: Click a platform to enter, change or delete the account details.
social.channelEmpty: This platform is not connected yet.
social.clientSecretHint: Leave empty to keep the current secret.
social.redirectUri: Redirect URI in the developer app
social.appSaved: Saved. Log in now to connect the account.
social.setupApp: Save the app credentials. Then log in at the platform.
social.linkedinChooseTitle: Which account do you want to connect?
social.linkedinChooseLead: Choose your personal profile or a company page you manage. You can connect again later for the other account.
social.facebookChooseLead: Choose the Facebook business Page to connect.
social.publishedLead: Performance per platform. A weak post on one channel says nothing about another channel.
social.emptyPublished: No published posts yet. Fetch history on
social.emptyPlatform: No published posts on this platform.
social.facebookConnectHint: Log in at Facebook and choose the business Page. Add the redirect URI under Facebook Login in the Meta app.
social.instagramConnectHint: Use the Instagram App ID and Instagram App Secret from the Meta app, under Instagram → Business login settings. The Facebook app ID does not work here. Add the https redirect URI below in Instagram. Http and https on this address open the same dashboard.
social.facebookProfilePosts: This is a personal profile. Disconnect it and connect again, then choose the business Page.
social.emptyCalendar: No posts yet. Connect an account and posts published outside this app show up here.
social.noChannelsLead: Connect your social accounts to start scheduling, publishing, and analyzing — all in one place.
social.channelVisibility: Display only. The connection stays active.
social.videoHint: YouTube and TikTok need a video. Instagram needs an image.

seo.title: SEO / GEO writer
seo.lead: Write articles that continue what is already published, or a new theme when you ask for one.

outreach.title: Outreach
outreach.lead: Set up an acquisition flow, approve the emails and schedule them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: The free text model is on by default. Paid keys stay in .env.
settings.storageLead: Files stay on local PocketBase storage, or in an S3 bucket. This applies to the whole installation.
settings.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current secret
settings.usersLead: PocketBase accounts. The first user is an admin.

chat.confirmDelete: Delete this chat? The messages will be removed.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribed
unsubscribe.lead: You will not receive further emails from this sequence.
